verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents a plain-English summary plus the actual diff (docs-20), and agent-captured screenshots and video so teams can review changes before approving (docs-21), with approvals logged (docs-23). However, the documented approval point is Review Hub, where engineers check readiness and merge existing pull requests (docs-8, docs-12), not a gate before the PR is opened. missing for 10: explicit evidence of a pre-PR approval gate, detail on where and how the diff review UI works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
